cp15:1.1: Punāparaṃ yadā homi mahiso pavanacārako pavaḍḍhakāyo balavā mahanto bhīmadassano. || ||
cp15:2.1: Pabbhāre giridugge ca rukkhamūle dakāsaye hot' ettha ṭhānaṃ mahisānam koci koci tahiṃ tahiṃ. || ||
cp15:3.1: Vicaranto brahāraññe ṭhānaṃ addasa bhaddakaṃ taṃ ṭhānaṃ upagantvāna tiṭṭhāmi ca sayāmi ca. || ||
cp15:4.1: Ath' ettha kapi-m-āgantvā pāpo anariyo lahu khandhe nalāṭe bhamuke mutteti ohaneti taṃ. || ||
cp15:5.1: Sakim-pi divasaṃ dutiyaṃ tatiyaṃ catuttham-pi ca dūseti maṃ sabbakālaṃ tena homi upadduto. || ||
cp15:6.1: Mamaṃ upaddutaṃ disvā yakkho maṃ idam-abravi: nāseh' etaṃ chavaṃ pāpaṃ siṅgehi ca khurehi ca. || ||
cp15:7.1: Evaṃ vutte tadā yakkhe ahaṃ taṃ idam-abraviṃ: kin-tvaṃ makkhesi kuṇapena pāpena anariyena maṃ. || ||
cp15:8.1: Yadi' haṃ tassa pakuppeyyaṃ tato hīnataro bhave sīlañca me pabhijjeyya viññū ca garaheyyu maṃ. || ||
cp15:9.1: Hīḷitā jīvitā vā pi parisuddhena mataṃ varaṃ kyāhaṃ jīvitahetū pi kāhāmi paraheṭhanaṃ. || ||
cp15:10.1: Mam-evāyaṃ maññamāno aññe p' evaṃ karissati te' va tattha vadhissanti sā me mutti bhavissati. || ||
cp15:11.1: Hīnamajjhima-ukkaṭṭhe sahanto avamānitaṃ evaṃ labhati sappañño manasā yathā patthitan-ti. || ||
